name: Shinsung Delta Tech Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shinsung Delta Tech Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells household electronic components, plastic molded products, and TFT-LCD components for notebook computers in in South Korea and internationally. It offers washing machines, dryers, refrigerators, vacuum cleaners, electric ranges, shoe stylers, and handheld and robot vacuum cleaners. The company also produces cell cartridges, lifting frames, heat sinks, and busbars used in electric vehicles and ESS. In addition, it engages in transportation, storage, and unloading of materials and products, as well as processing, assembly, packaging, and supplier-driven inventory management businesses.
